script_text: Whoa—Leo and Virgo don't merely clash; they complete each other's operating system. Saturn in Aries trines Leo's 1st-house Sun but squares Virgo's 6th-house Sun, so Leo feels supported while Virgo feels overworked; this 7th-house bond can last if Leo stops competing and Virgo stops managing. One break or breakthrough: praise the work before improving it. Comment your partner's sign!
